title: lastrea flexilis
intro: Lastrea flexilis, commonly known as the Mountain Fern, is a type of fern species that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in the treatment of various skin conditions due to its antibacterial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea flexilis include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
